newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Darling Park Trust lists at A$1.00.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Darling Park Trust lists at A$1.00.

text.p: Units in the Darling Park Trust made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange on Thursday at a price of A$1.00, the same as the first instalment of the public offering.

The trust offered 130 million units at A$2.50 each, partly paid to A$1.00 with the final instalment of A$1.50 per unit due on December 31, 1999, when the Darling Park commercial property project reaches completion.
The Trust's interest in the Darling Park project at Darling Harbour in Sydney is its major asset.
The Trust is managed by property and financial services conglomerate Lend Lease Corp Ltd.
By 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), Darling Park units were trading at A$1.00 on turnover of 4.75 million shares after reaching a high of A$1.01.
